description: This file defines the ReviewerRatingModel class, which is a data model for representing reviewer ratings within the Performance API module of the OrangeHRM project. It uses traits and annotations to facilitate serialization, filtering, and normalization of ReviewerRating entities for API responses.

classes.name: ReviewerRatingModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing ReviewerRating entities into API responses with specified filters and attribute mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ReviewerRating entity, sets up filters and attribute mappings.
